denominator.blocked_auth: an unauthorized full round reports BLOCKED_AUTH and does NOT fabricate a zero-score benchmark
denominator.conditional_accuracy: successes / actually-scored; reported as context only, never as the gate metric
denominator.rule: successRate = successes / scheduled attempts (full frozen plan task x variant x arm x repeat); failures, timeouts, missing and blocked rows stay in the denominator with taskSuccess null or false

purpose: R02: pins the single-scorer, strict-answer, full-denominator evaluation protocol for the release audit. Any divergence between code and this file is a protocol violation.

requires_all: strict answer equal to frozen gold
every frozen required line (path,start_line..end_line) covered by a SOURCE_RECEIVED event of this attempt

receipts.MODEL_TOOL_DELIVERED: minted only at the chat request boundary; contentHash is the model-payload hash; proves payload attachment, NOT model attention
receipts.SOURCE_RECEIVED: raw-side: source text actually returned by the tool (sha256 of that text)
receipts.attention: never claimed; only answer/test results measure understanding

repair_success.passed_must_be: boolean true exactly (Promise/truthy object are not successes)
repair_success.source: frozen judge only (repairTester / kit run_repair); candidate self-report (patchApplied) is never a success

repeat_index: 0-based in the kit (java-specialist-results/v1); 1-based in internal task-eval packs - the adapter converts

scorer.adapter: scripts/eval-frozen-adapter.mjs converts scheduled attempts + SOURCE_RECEIVED events + provider usage into java-specialist-results/v1
scorer.invoke: python3 -m harness score --input <results.json> --split all --output <score.json> (run from kit root)
scorer.no_second_comparator: no String() coercion, no fence stripping, no gold mutation; markdown fences are a format failure (INVALID_ANSWER), never silently accepted
scorer.single_scorer: docs/java-specialist-devkit-v1 harness scorer (harness/scoring.py); node-side scoreQaAnswer/receivedLineCoverage are locked to the same semantics by scripts/eval-frozen-adapter.test.mjs

strict_json.fences: rejected (strict JSON only in this audit round)
strict_json.keys: exact key set equality with frozen gold; extra and missing keys both fail
strict_json.parser: JSON.parse + findDuplicateJsonKeys state machine (equivalent to Python json.loads with object_pairs_hook; nested duplicate keys rejected; NaN/Infinity literals rejected by the JSON grammar)
strict_json.values: type identity + deep equality (JS has one number type: int/float not distinguishable - recorded limitation)

usage.kit_row: {source: 'provider', input_tokens?, output_tokens?, cached_input_tokens?} - only measured int fields; all-null becomes null
usage.provider_raw: rawUsage (provider usage object; credentials never appear in it) + rawUsageHash (sha256 of canonical JSON) stored per attempt
usage.unmeasured: null per field, never 0, never bytes/4 estimates
